name: Hy4 flash Base

lineage.how_derived: pre-trained base checkpoint of Hy4 flash; the instruct model hy4-flash is post-trained from it

purpose: The card says Hy4 flash-base is a pre-trained base model, not an instruction-tuned chat model; the same repository card as the instruct model is shipped, the chat examples apply to Hy4 flash.

license.name: Tencent Hy License, Version 1.0
license.notes: Same LICENSE text as the instruct model (read in full): Apache-2.0 derived; a Model-as-a-Service operator above US$50 million annual revenue, or a product above 100 million monthly active users, needs a separate written licence; internal use exempt; no territory exclusion in the text.

architecture.kind: sparse MoE with LatentMoE, hybrid sparse and sliding-window MLA attention, Engram tables (same as hy4-flash)
architecture.drafter: none on the base (the DFly2 drafter belongs to the instruct model)

variants.notes: no GGUF or other quantised repo of the base found (HF API lists 0 derivatives, 2026-11-19)

pc-12gb.notes: 438.8 GB BF16 and no quantised base exists; also not an instruct model

pc-32gb.notes: no quantised base; the instruct model's GGUFs (see hy4-flash) are the usable form

engine_support.notes: Only the instruct model's GGUFs exist (llama.cpp PR #32517 unmerged).

weaknesses: Base model: the card warns that mid-training on synthetic instruction data makes it occasionally miss the expected answer format in few-shot evaluation
soft.maturity: Released together with the instruct model; days old.

tona_fit.reason: A base checkpoint, not an agent or chat model, 438.8 GB and without any quantised release. The useful artefact for our users is the instruct model, see hy4-flash.

sources.note: README with the few-shot base table, config.json, file sizes via the HF API (0 derivatives)
LICENSE file present and the same size as the instruct model's (13,942 bytes); the instruct text was read in full

open_questions: Whether a quantised base ever appears (only useful for research)
